description: Teach-mode + passive coaching during history. Educational only.

modules.title: Black stools — history structure
points: Melena is a stool appearance (black, tarry), not a diagnosis of UGIB.
Confirm tarry character and exclude iron/bismuth/food confounders before escalating.
Ask about blood in vomitus and haemodynamic symptoms — these may later support an upper GI bleeding diagnosis.
Massive upper bleeding can also present with hematochezia — keep both symptoms on the board.

Q000111.why_ask: Iron and bismuth commonly mimic melena without bleeding.
Q000111.think: Dark non-tarry stool on iron ≠ melena.

Q000112.why_ask: True melena is sticky/tar-like; mere dark colour is weaker evidence.
Q000112.think: Tarry + occult blood context strengthens bleeding concern.

answer_triggers.title: Unlocked: possible non-bleed dark stool
points: Iron/bismuth can darken stool without GI bleeding.
Still examine for haemodynamic compromise if the story is unclear.
